a-fishing-spear.name: A Fishing Spear
a-fishing-spear.description:
The barbed prongs on this fishing spear make it easier to catch fish with smooth skin. 

Obtained from Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). This spear is most effective on the following Plains of Eidolon fish:
Charc Eel
Cuthol
Goopolla
Murkray
Sharrac
Yogwun

adrenal-stim.name: Adrenal Stim
adrenal-stim.description: Elevates adrenaline levels to enable faster movement while increasing sensitivity to damage.

advanced-nosam-cutter.name: Advanced Nosam Cutter
advanced-nosam-cutter.description:
Enhanced with cybernetics, this tool is able to locate nearby gems and ore veins and has chance to retrieve Rare Gems on any Landscape.

Travel far from Hub settlements for the best chance of mining rare minerals.

air-support-charges.name: Air Support Charges
air-support-charges.description: Charges consumed by Landing Craft Air Support.

alpha-corruptor.name: Alpha Corruptor
alpha-corruptor.description: Inert on its own this corruptor is highly effective if mixed with its Beta counterpart. Properly mixed, these will destabilize Fomorian Reactors much faster than their Stable counterparts. This volatile item cannot be simultaneously equipped with Beta Corruptors. Recommended for Tenno operating as a team.

amethyst-antitoxin.name: Amethyst Antitoxin
amethyst-antitoxin.description: This is a mildly effective antitoxin.

ancient-protector-specter.name: Ancient Protector Specter
ancient-protector-specter.description: Deploys an ANCIENT PROTECTOR EXIMUS unit to fight for you.

antiserum-injector.name: Antiserum Injector
antiserum-injector.description: Injects antiserum into Vaporizers or the user to prevent armor degradation.

archgun-deployer.name: Archgun Deployer
archgun-deployer.description: Deploy the selected archwing gun in any atmospheric environment using this gear item.

archwing-launcher.name: Archwing Launcher
archwing-launcher.description: Summons an Archwing for use during free roam missions.

atomicycle-summon.name: Atomicycle Summon
atomicycle-summon.description: Summons an Atomicycle for use in 1999 and free roam missions.

avichaea-echo-lure.name: Avichaea Echo-Lure
avichaea-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Avichaea with life-like animal calls.

avichaea-pheromone-gland.name: Avichaea Pheromone Gland
avichaea-pheromone-gland.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Avichaea.
